scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:shared && pnpm run prepare:weapp && cross-env TARO_APP_ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN=1 NODE_ENV=production HOME=../../.cache/taro-home taro build --type weapp
scripts.build:prod: pnpm run prepare:shared && pnpm run prepare:weapp && cross-env NODE_ENV=production HOME=../../.cache/taro-home taro build --type weapp
scripts.build:h5: pnpm run prepare:shared && node -e "fs.mkdirSync('../../.cache/taro-home',{recursive:true})" && cross-env HOME=../../.cache/taro-home taro build --type h5
scripts.dev: pnpm run prepare:shared && pnpm run prepare:weapp && cross-env TARO_APP_ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN=1 NODE_ENV=production HOME=../../.cache/taro-home taro build --type weapp --watch
scripts.dev:h5: pnpm run prepare:shared && node -e "fs.mkdirSync('../../.cache/taro-home',{recursive:true})" && cross-env HOME=../../.cache/taro-home taro build --type h5 --watch
